t: Erbauer impact driver, featuring durable protective metal gearbox housing and advanced brushless motor technology for optimal power and up to 160Nm torque. Includes LED light for work in poorly lit areas. Keep Cool battery technology actively manages temperature, so cells do not overheat, resulting in improved power, run time and battery life. Supplied with belt clip. Part of the Erbauer EXT and EXT EliteCell, one battery system, running multiple tools for increased flexibility. Compatible with all Erbauer 18V EXT and EXT EliteCell batteries and chargers.
